articles.title: To write more call summaries, please visit A.
articles.description: SK Telecom has limited the basic allowance for AI call summarization to 30 uses per month and is offering additional usage as rewards for visits to the ‘A.’ app and website. Customers who want to use call summaries more need to visit the A. app or website, which are operated separately. There are criticisms that SK Telecom is using call summary benefits to expand A.’s subscribers and visitors rather than focusing on customer convenience. A model is promoting SK Telecom’s ‘A. Phone.’ / SK Telecom SK Telecom provides A. Phone users with 30 AI call summaries per month as a standard feature. After using all 30 calls, customers must meet conditions set by SK Telecom, such as visiting the A. app or website, to continue using the call summary service. The A. Phone app and the AI agent, the A. app, operate separately. The calling and recording features are available even without subscribing to the A. service. However, to use the service to summarize recorded calls, you must sign up for the A. service, agree to its terms, and connect to an A. phone. The process of receiving additional call summary usage counts is more complex. SK Telecom will provide an additional 120 call summaries to customers who visit the A. app. After using the base 30 uses and the additional 120 uses, 100 more uses are granted on the condition of visiting the A. app. Visit the A. website to get 100 more. The customer can receive a total of up to 350 call summaries per month, combining a base of 30 and an additional 320. The additional storage is more than ten times the built-in amount. In effect, SK Telecom has tied most of the call summary usage to the conditions of visits to the A. app and website. The problem is that the additional call usage credit is granted based on visits to A.’s app or website, a separate service, rather than actual A. phone usage. The feature customers want is a call summary, but to receive the benefits, they must subscribe to other services and visit the app and website. The difference between the base and additional credits is also significant. SK Telecom provided only 30 call summaries per month by default, allocating up to 320 as rewards for app and web visits. This is why critics say it is contradictory to claim that service usage should be limited while offering a large amount of additional usage through separate app and web visit conditions. The difference is even more pronounced when compared to competitors’ services. LG Uplus's AI call service ‘ICSYO’ allows users to access call summaries through a simple login using their phone number and date of birth. There is no limit to the number of monthly call summaries, according to the official guidelines. One customer said, “SK Telecom designed the conditions for receiving additional call summaries more strictly than other carriers,” adding, “It seems they ultimately want to increase A. subscribers and app/web visitors through the call summary benefits.” SK Telecom says it set the usage policy with user convenience and system operation conditions in mind. However, they did not provide a specific reason for linking the additional call summaries to visits to the A. app and website. An SK Telecom representative stated, “We operate detailed usage policies by comprehensively considering service volume, user convenience, and system operating conditions,” adding, “We will continue to improve the AI services so that users can use them more conveniently, such as call summaries.” He went on to explain, “Basic registration and authentication procedures are required to use the A. service, including AI call summarization,” adding, “These steps are in place to verify users and ensure the service is provided reliably.” fun3503@chosunbiz.com
